def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 1
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (nil...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (nil).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 167
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  self.each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (1...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

    if nil

  end

  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if nil =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (167...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ //
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /nomatch\A/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 0
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if true
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.even?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return false
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

  end
  idx < line_idx

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if self.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)

    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    true

  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    nil
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

end

    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    nil
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return true
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/

  end
  if line_idx.zero?

  end
  idx = line_idx

    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

  end
  idx = line_idx

      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.negative?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

  end

end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  until idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?

  end
  idx = line_idx

    line = lines[idx]
    unless nil
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ //
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless true
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /nomatch\A/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless false
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= nil
  end
  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  nil < line_idx
end

    idx += 1

  idx < line_idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  nil
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)

  if fence_count.odd?
    return true

  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx.equal?(line_idx)
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  idx
end

def self.in_code_fence?(lines, line_idx)
  fence_count = 0
  (0...line_idx).each { |i|
    if lines[i] =~ /^(`{3,}|~{3,})/
      fence_count += 1
    end
  }
  if fence_count.odd?
    return true
  end
  if line_idx.zero?
    return false
  end
  idx = line_idx
  while idx.positive?
    line = lines[idx]
    unless line =~ /^(    |\t)/
      break
    end
    idx -= 1
  end
  line_idx
end

def self.process_post_render(document)
  output = document.output
  unless output
    return
  end
  output = output.dup
  output.gsub!(/(<img\s+[^>]*>)\s*<!--\s*IMG_SIZE:([^:]*):([^:]*)\s*-->/)
  document.output=output
end

  output = document.output

  output = output.dup
  output.gsub!(/(<img\s+[^>]*>)\s*<!--\s*IMG_SIZE:([^:]*):([^:]*)\s*-->/) {
    raise
  }
  document.output=output
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = self.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  return
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content

    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = nil
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next

    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  if content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

      next

      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)

        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  self.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    nil
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(nil, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result >> line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if nil
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      nil << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << nil
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      break
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"

  }

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    self.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub! { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[(?:[^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=(?:[^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\((?:[^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\S+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(//) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)])\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = self.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)])\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = self.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(nil)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = 0
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(-1)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(167)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)

    return

  lines = content.lines
  result = []

      result << line

    processed_line = line.dup

      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)

        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if nil
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if false
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      (alt = Regexp.last_match(1); src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip; size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip; (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size); "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->")
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      match
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = nil
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(nil)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = 2.strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = nil
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = self.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = self.strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(0).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(nil).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = nil
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line

    processed_line = line.dup

        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match.strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = 3.strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(nil).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = self.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(4).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(167).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(0).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = nil
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = self.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = size
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        nil
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(nil)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      unless in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

  content = document.content
  unless content
    return

  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|

      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)

        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"

    }

  }
  document.content=result.join

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result >> processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    processed_line
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result
  }
  document.content=result.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  nil
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document.content=self.join
end

def self.process_pre_render(document)
  content = document.content
  unless content
    return
  end
  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|
    if in_code_fence?(lines, idx)
      result << line
      next
    end
    processed_line = line.dup
    processed_line.gsub!(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\s+=([^)]+)\)/) { |match|
      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else
        alt = Regexp.last_match(1)
        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
  document
end

  content = document.content

    return

  lines = content.lines
  result = []
  lines.each_with_index { |line, idx|

      next
    end

      match_start = Regexp.last_match.begin(0)
      if in_inline_code?(line, match_start)
        match
      else

        src = Regexp.last_match(2).strip
        size = Regexp.last_match(3).strip
        (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(size)
        "![#{alt}](#{src})<!-- IMG_SIZE:#{width}:#{height} -->"
      end
    }
    result << processed_line
  }
